verdict.rationale: Warp's own site says its agent runs payroll, with tax registrations, filings and payments handled across all 50 states, which covers US employee payroll. The same platform advertises paying contractors in 150+ countries with local currency and invoicing, so both worker types are paid from one product. missing for 10: explicit mention of W-2 and 1099 form generation/filing, detailed docs on a unified employee-plus-contractor pay run, and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.
